buildupmobtweaks.main.passive.squid_ink_: Native hurt ink affects at most 16 living entities within 8 blocks: blindness for squid, glowing for glow squid. 100-tick cooldown; creative and spectator players excluded.
buildupmobtweaks.main.passive.glow_squid: Every 60 ticks checks at most 8 players within 16 blocks. Direct gaze and line of sight grant 600 ticks of night vision.
buildupmobtweaks.main.passive.chicken_th: Native Goal scheduling flees players within 8 blocks and monsters within 6. Chicken food holders, creative and spectator players are excluded; feeding and breeding remain native.
buildupmobtweaks.main.passive.animal_gro: Hurt-triggered native panic in chickens, cows, sheep, pigs and rabbits sends one 60-tick escape signal to at most 8 same-species neighbors within 16 blocks. 200-tick cooldown; no recursive spread.
buildupmobtweaks.main.passive.tameable_r: Tamed pets with an active owner in the same level wait 200 ticks after damage, then heal 1 every 100 ticks. Combat, fire and riding pause recovery; cooldowns persist and an exclusion tag is available.
buildupmobtweaks.main.passive.cat_projec: Predicts incoming trajectories from at most 8 moving projectiles within 8 blocks; a small sideways jump requires safe ground. 40-tick cooldown; sitting and riding excluded. No immunity or generated items.
buildupmobtweaks.main.passive.goat_horn_: Successful native instrument use attracts at most 16 visible native monsters within 24 blocks. Existing non-player targets remain; owned targets exit when use ends or after 60 ticks. 100-tick request cooldown.
buildupmobtweaks.main.passive.trader_sel: After actual damage, a native Goal winds up for 20 ticks and blinds a valid visible attacker within 8 blocks for 100 ticks. 200-tick cooldown; no generated potion or equipment changes.
buildupmobtweaks.main.passive.sniffer_se: Sneak with an allowed item and interact with an adult sniffer to search loaded chunks for ore or biomes. Server limit: 64 queries/tick, 8 requests, 100-tick timeout. Changing items or leaving cancels; no new chunks load.
buildupmobtweaks.sniffer.started: The sniffer is searching the loaded area. Stay sneaking and keep holding the same item.
buildupmobtweaks.sniffer.found: The sniffer found a nearby scent. Particles point toward it.
buildupmobtweaks.sniffer.not_found: No scent was found within the loaded area and this request's query budget.
buildupmobtweaks.sniffer.cooldown: The sniffer is resting. Try again shortly.
buildupmobtweaks.sniffer.busy: The search queue is full. Try again shortly.
buildupmobtweaks.main.desc: R2-A: only rebuilt pillager behaviors are active. Other retained S2 options are dormant. Only server owners (permission level 4) may apply changes.
buildupmobtweaks.main.general.enabled.de: Master feature gate. Saved data and actual items remain. Existing trident ownership transactions still finish safely; read-only queries remain available.
buildupmobtweaks.main.general.diagnostic: Allow /buildupmobtweaks probe to print a bounded response for server owners. Does not change the world. Effective immediately.
buildupmobtweaks.main.performance.diagno: Lines printed per probe command: 1–5, default 1. Effective immediately.
commands.buildupmobtweaks.disabled: The diagnostic probe is disabled by server settings.
commands.buildupmobtweaks.probe: Buildup configuration probe %s/%s: enabled on the server.
buildupmobtweaks.main.compatibility.desc: Reserved category. No settings or gameplay changes are available yet.
buildupmobtweaks.main.bosses.desc: Reserved category. No settings or gameplay changes are available yet.
buildupmobtweaks.main.traits.desc: Gate for diagnostic markers and advanced skeleton/zombie traits. Basic equipment use is independent; saved results never reroll.
buildupmobtweaks.main.neutral.desc: Reserved category. No settings or gameplay changes are available yet.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.desc: Skeleton, zombie, husk and drowned combat. Basic equipment use and advanced birth traits have separate gates.
buildupmobtweaks.main.passive.desc: Reserved category. No settings or gameplay changes are available yet.
buildupmobtweaks.main.fixes.desc: Reserved category. No settings or gameplay changes are available yet.
buildupmobtweaks.main.equipment.desc: Birth equipment pools for zombies, husks, drowned, wither skeletons and zombified piglins. Empty slots only, at most one matching rule; saved attempts never repeat.
buildupmobtweaks.main.traits.advancedMar: Enabled by default. Turning off masks saved markers immediately and excludes them from new rolls; saved results are never re-rolled.
buildupmobtweaks.main.traits.enabled.des: Enabled by default. Turning off masks saved markers immediately and excludes them from new rolls; saved results are never re-rolled.
Enabled by default. Turning off masks saved markers immediately and excludes them from new rolls; saved results are never re-rolled.
buildupmobtweaks.main.traits.commonMarke: Enabled by default. Turning off masks saved markers immediately and excludes them from new rolls; saved results are never re-rolled.
buildupmobtweaks.main.traits.cow.desc: One exclusive draw for new entities only. Weights use thousandths; totals above 1000 are normalized. Existing entities keep their results.
0–1000; default 200. New entities only. Zero excludes this marker; unused weight below 1000 means no marker.
buildupmobtweaks.main.traits.cow.advance: 0–1000; default 70. New entities only. Zero excludes this marker; unused weight below 1000 means no marker.
buildupmobtweaks.main.traits.cow.rare.de: 0–1000; default 10. New entities only. Zero excludes this marker; unused weight below 1000 means no marker.
buildupmobtweaks.main.traits.zombieFamil: One exclusive draw for new entities only. Weights use thousandths; totals above 1000 are normalized. Existing entities keep their results.
0–1000; default 100. New entities only. Zero excludes this marker; unused weight below 1000 means no marker.
0–1000; default 30. New entities only. Zero excludes this marker; unused weight below 1000 means no marker.
0–1000; default 5. New entities only. Zero excludes this marker; unused weight below 1000 means no marker.
buildupmobtweaks.main.equipment.poolAssi: Enabled by default. Applies to new entities only. Disabling preserves existing items; re-enabling does not equip old entities. Does not change AI or drop rates.
buildupmobtweaks.main.equipment.assignme: 0–1000; default 100 (10%). One ordinary empty-slot attempt; pool weights choose the item, independent of Traits. Wither main-hand bows and zombified piglin main-hand crossbows use the separate birth chances below.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.skeleton.s: Check flat footing for cliffs, fluids and obstacles. Disable to restore vanilla strafing.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.skeleton.t: Release dead, allied or unattackable stored targets. Keep vanilla target selection.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.skeleton.w: Fresh bow users receive one owned reserve wooden sword. Switch below 3 blocks and return the original bow above 3; preserve items, durability and drop chances. Loading never refills.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.skeleton.b: Allow BowItem through vanilla skeleton shooting. Unknown implementations keep vanilla AI; not universal mod-bow compatibility.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.skeleton.s: Use a real drawn-bow sniper goal in daylight or under cover; walk and strafe under the night sky. Independent of legacy trait rolls.
120-tick cooldown. Safely flip after drawing for 10 ticks beyond 6 blocks, or when unarmed; throw real snowballs during the 19-tick action. Vanilla slowness arrows remain.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.skeleton.b: 120-tick cooldown. Dodge safely within 6 or beyond 15 blocks and create an expanding poison cloud lasting 40 ticks. Exit, disable and loading clear in-flight actions.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.skeleton.s: Retained legacy S2 probability setting; unused by this rebuild.
Retained legacy S2 probability setting; unused by this rebuild.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.skeleton.b: Retained legacy S2 probability setting; unused by this rebuild.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.skeleton.d: This rebuild covers Skeleton, Stray and Bogged only. Independent toggles; legacy Traits probabilities do not gate these behaviors.
commands.buildupmobtweaks.zombie: Zombie for %s: saved=%s; flight=%s; owned=%s; gates=%s
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.zombie.bab: One eligible natural or spawn-egg birth may create at most one same-family baby passenger, exclusive with the door. No recruitment or load refill. Disabling detaches it; normal despawn rules still apply.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.drowned.tr: Walk or swim within 32 blocks to an owned trident that hit or landed. Return the actual weapon only to an empty main hand within 1.5 blocks with line of sight; no backup copy.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.zombie.doo: Eligible adult natural births may own a real door display above local difficulty 2.5. A 10-degree frontal block wears material durability. Breaking removes it; existing equipment remains.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.drowned.tr: New throws remove the actual held trident. Disabling restores vanilla future throws; existing ownership cleanup continues safely.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.zombie.act: Retained legacy field. Advanced active guarding is outside R2-C and currently inactive.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.zombie.shi: Adults use an existing offhand vanilla shield against visible targets within 3 blocks for 15 ticks, with an 80-tick cooldown. Actual blocks wear the shield; no shield is generated.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.zombie.des: This batch covers Zombie and Husk only. Door and same-family baby riders share one birth draw gated by Traits. Basic shields and Husk burrowing are independent.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.zombie.san: Beyond 12 blocks on a continuous three-layer sand route with mobGriefing enabled: sink, relocate to the target snapshot, then rise across 40 vanilla Goal updates. Interruptions and loading restore a safe surface and physics. Default world-time cooldown: 200 ticks.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.drowned.tr: After timeout, roll original base drop chance once; honor mob drops and vanishing. No looting bonus. Disabling masks released pickups too.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.drowned.de: Transfer the actual held vanilla trident into one projectile. Never create replacement weapons.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.zombie.doo: 0-1000, default 30. Shares an exclusive per-thousand birth draw with baby riders; totals above 1000 use the total weight. Existing births never reroll.
Retained legacy field. Door blocks use remaining material durability, not this action cooldown.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.zombie.gua: Retained legacy field; advanced guard probability is unused in this batch.
Retained legacy field. Basic shields use an 80-tick cooldown; advanced guarding remains inactive.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.zombie.bur: Retained legacy field. Burrowing is gated by distance, sand, game rules and cooldown; no probability draw.
60-2400 ticks; default 200. New actions reserve the cooldown; changing it does not reset saved deadlines.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.zombie.rid: 0-1000, default 10. Shares one exclusive birth draw with the door; at most one same-family baby.
Retained legacy field. Riders are drawn only at the first eligible birth; this cooldown is unused.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.drowned.re: 40-1200 ticks; default 200. New throws only. Expiry releases the original weapon under its saved drop policy; never backfills.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.raid.desc: Seven independent server features, no advanced Trait required. No changes to terrain or raid membership.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.raid.evoke: Keep vanilla spell telegraph; additional cooldown survives reload. Disabling resumes vanilla checks without deleting vexes.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.raid.pilla: On Normal/Hard, retreat from a visible target within 6 blocks; slow down during use and check footing. No terrain changes.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.raid.vindi: When idle, inspect at most 8 allied casters within 8 blocks every 20 ticks; target a visible recent attacker. Keep existing targets.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.raid.pilla: Swap with actual inventory weapons: melee below 3 blocks, crossbow above 3. Preserve components, durability and drop chances; return the owned crossbow when disabled.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.raid.summo: 340-2400 ticks; default 680. New casts only; saved deadlines do not reset.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.raid.witch: Preview the actual vanilla potion with item particles; never equip lootable preview items. Cancel on drinking, target change, lost sight or disable. Keep ally healing.
Persistent minimum interval between accepted throws, including ally support; independent of windup. Keep vanilla potion selection.
10-60 ticks; default 20. New windups only. Interrupted or unloaded windups never resume firing.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.raid.evoke: Count registered owned vexes across loaded and unloaded chunks and dimensions using a persistent world ledger. Pre-upgrade unloaded vexes become known on first load. Reserve three slots before summoning.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.raid.vexLi: 3-24; default 6. Full batches of three only. Unloaded vexes and those outside 32 blocks are excluded.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.raid.witch: 60-400 ticks; default 100. New throws only; saved cooldowns retained.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.vex.recove: 10-60 ticks; default 20. External knockback remains possible while AI flight pauses.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.vex.fixedC: Aim once at charge start; stop missed charges after 40 ticks. Keeps vanilla hit damage and charge sound.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.vex.minimu: 2-6 blocks; default 3. Start only beyond this distance, keeping vanilla random checks.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.vex.closeR: Extend the vanilla two-block start boundary to the configured distance. Does not cancel a charge already in progress.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.vex.recove: Pause AI flight after a charge. Saves recovery across reloads; interrupted charges reserve up to 40 ticks plus recovery.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.d: Independent gates. Birth rolls and assigned equipment are not rerolled on reload. See S2_COMBAT.md for limits.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.s: Skeleton Aim Fix
Keep vertical bow aim through LookControl while strafing.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.g: Prevent iron golem revenge against native iron or snow golems. Keep actual damage, player revenge and village defense.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.z: Zombified Piglin Anger Fix
Keep same-species damage but prevent retaliation and anger propagation; preserve vanilla player alerts.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.s: Strafe Hazard Check
Ground MoveControl only: reject fluids, drops and unsafe ground without forward fallback.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.m: Only rebuilt walking/sniping skeleton movement; hold the last actual horizontal input for at most 12 airborne ticks, with target and phase exit cleanup.
Clear lateral input during owned skeleton WAIT on ground or after the airborne budget; preserves native navigation and other entities.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.s: Bounded strafe obstacle jump
Owned skeleton strafe can jump one safe block. Doors, fences, fluids, hazards and blocked ceilings are excluded; native navigation jump remains.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.p: Swing the actual firing hand after a real Piglin crossbow shot; empty attempts do not swing.
A 7% birth trait: safely jump back while charging a crossbow within 2 blocks of a target; 200-tick cooldown. Does not dodge dropped items.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.s: Skeleton Offhand Visual
Render the standard BowItem pose for the actual hand in use.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.d: Synced visual-only upstream -80-degree swimming basis and head adjustment. No hitbox, speed or trident changes; gate restores native -10 basis.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.b: One flame particle every 4 ticks only for genuinely burning projectiles with supported owners; no damage, fire duration or explosion changes.
Supported nonimmune burning mobs receive orange tint; fully frozen mobs receive light blue. Preserves original tint alpha, hurt overlay, armor and invisibility.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.u: Inactive: legacy sunburn design deferred to Phase 2. The saved option is retained and does not ignite horses.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.h: After actual damage, a fighting native hostile may leave an existing boat if a safe landing exists. Chance follows damage/max health; 100-tick attempt cooldown. No tagged-seat takeover.
Fresh hostiles without a major trait have a one-time 3% roll for 600 ticks of speed or fire resistance.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.s: Spider Hunts Pests
Idle spiders search within eight blocks for silverfish or endermites every 40 ticks.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.c: Add flame particles to burning creeper explosions; no extra ignition or explosion.
Rewind the fuse by five ticks on damage, at most once every ten ticks.
Release at most eight weak, unpickable embedded arrows on explosion.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.i: Ominous animal attacks may trigger an illusioner; one within 32 blocks and 1200-tick success cooldown.
Pillagers, vindicators, evokers and illusioners may fight plain zombies when idle. Preserve native player/village targets and vindicator support. Husk/drowned variants are excluded.
Independent mutual hostility between the four native illagers and zombie villagers. Search at most every 20 ticks within 16 blocks; retire own relationship targets when curing begins.
Fresh raid or patrol illagers in deep water may create one boat and control only their own occupied boat.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.h: Inactive replacement option: vanilla 26.3 already handles actual mounted spear use and damage. This retained toggle does not disable vanilla spear AI.
The primary husk rider circles on an existing CamelHusk outside actual spear use. Safe loaded ground only; no constant healing, speed stacking or target sharing.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.s: Skeleton Horse Charge
Selected skeleton riders charge on an existing skeleton horse: 20-tick warning, at most 20-tick charge, one collision hit capped at 4 damage, 200-tick cooldown. Never creates a horse.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.c: Selected baby zombie riders pounce on an existing jockey chicken, at most once per 100 ticks with safe ground ahead. Native attacks continue; no extra chicken is created.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.z: Zombie Slime Carrier
Create one vanilla size-2 slime for a rare zombie; throw the original passenger after 20 ticks, never replace it.
Zombie Horse Leader
A rare fresh zombie may create one zombie horse and receive a non-dropping banner in an empty head slot.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.p: Adapt CrossbowItem subclasses, actual hands, range and arm poses; preserve vanilla Brain and barter equipment transfers.
While injured and out of combat, wait 60 ticks, borrow the offhand to consume inventory food, then heal by nutrition. Interruptions and reload restore the original item.
Approach a target blocking over 60 ticks when an owned melee weapon is available. Shield disabling requires an actual vanilla axe melee hit. Requires weapon switching.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.d: Cast a real main- or off-hand rod at visible targets 6-13 blocks away and outside water; reel costs 3 durability, cooldown 60 ticks. In-flight tridents take priority.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.z: Zombified Piglin Spawn Crossbow
A matching pool rarely selects a real crossbow in an empty birth hand (default 1%), preserving existing items. Crossbow combat AI is a later batch; this option does not add shooting.
Zombified Piglin Crossbow
Load and fire an actual main- or off-hand vanilla crossbow with durability costs; retain native anger, components and loaded ammunition. Birth crossbows have a separate setting.
Zombie Fisherman Rod
Fresh fisherman zombie villagers receive one rod in an empty hand. Real hooks pull visible targets 6-13 blocks away; reel costs 3 durability, cooldown 60 ticks, no refills.
Zombie Cleric Potions

Fresh cleric zombie villagers receive one real harming splash potion. After 20 ticks of preparation, consume it to heal visible injured undead within 12 blocks; cooldown 60 ticks, no refills or hostile-target changes.
Zombie Fletcher Crossbow
Fresh fletcher zombie villagers receive one crossbow in an empty hand; load and fire the actual main- or off-hand weapon with durability costs. Retain loaded ammunition, no refills.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.r: Buildup safety: filter arrows/tridents from an active mob shooter against its current riding tree only. Dismounting or changing mounts releases the old tree. Enemy mounts, player shooters, other damage and disabled vanilla behavior remain unaffected.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.s: Skeleton Trap Variants

Preserve the native four-horse trap event. Keep its first skeleton and replace the three added riders with wither skeleton, stray and bogged, transferring actual enchanted equipment. No extra horses or rewards.
Skeleton Wither Conversion

A plain skeleton killed while withered or by a wither/wither skeleton converts once, transferring actual equipment and external reserve items. No immediate extra XP or drops; generated backup wooden swords remain nondroppable.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.w: New births may receive a rare real bow through equipment pools; shots use real durability. Disabling retains existing gear and native bow AI, with no refunds or replenishment.
Owned special skulls gently track a visible ominous target for the first 40 ticks within 32 blocks. They never retarget after target exit.
One birth selection; one non-dangerous skull after 30 warning ticks, vanilla direct-hit damage, no lingering Wither, terrain damage or fire. 400-tick cooldown; 100-tick lifetime.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.p: One birth selection; 20 warning ticks then a jump and spinning sidestep for up to 10 ticks. 120-tick cooldown; exit preserves external knockback.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.b: Two slow mushroom projectiles create brief small harming clouds near ominous targets; 300-tick cooldown, no item drops.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.s: Stray Omen Snow
Accelerate existing special snowballs against ominous targets; does not create a barrage on its own.
Stray Snow Barrage
Exclusive trait on hard difficulty or without a bow: warn for 20 ticks, jump and fire three snowballs while falling; 400-tick cooldown.
Skeleton Shelter
Seek reachable daytime cover within 8 blocks without changing blocks; navigate up to 80 ticks and wait 100 ticks after stopping. Independent of random repositioning.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.i: Swap to a safe illusion position on first invisibility, hurt completion or periodic refresh; 200-tick cooldown, no invulnerability.
Keep native bow/spell scheduling; stop while drawing, recover for 20 ticks after a shot and 10 ticks after swapping.
One birth roll; at most two unpickable illusion arrows replace one native shot every 120 ticks. Preserve real bow components, filter allies and expire after 200 ticks.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.e: Enderman Combo Animation
Show vanilla swings during the special combo; independent of the attack gate.
Enderman Combo
Selected once at birth (default 70/1000); after 60 approach ticks, up to three native safe teleports and melee attempts. Uses special skill cooldown (default 400 ticks); target loss cancels.
Enderman Speed
Apply a separate transient -15% movement modifier; remove it when disabled without replacing base attributes.
Evoker Fireball No Fire
Prevent this mod's evoker fireballs from igniting entities or blocks; leave other fireballs alone.
Evoker Totem
Rare exclusive trait: below 30% health and outside other spells, hold one real non-dropping totem for at most 40 ticks, once per lifetime.
Evoker Fireball
Exclusive trait: orbit particles warn for 40 ticks before three sequential fireballs, with no bonus rewards.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.h: Healthy idle zombies, skeletons, spiders and creepers may rarely rest for 200 ticks; damage wakes them.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.r: Wake resting mobs for eligible vibration events within eight blocks; respect sneaking exclusions, without wool occlusion simulation.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.w: For a higher target, replace self-drunk swiftness with leaping while preserving emergency potion priorities.
Jump late in a throw at a higher target with headroom; retain an eight-tick jump warning when normal windup is off.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.s: Silverfish hurt escape
After being hurt, jump, land, conceal and sidestep for a bounded period. Damage still applies; native help and merging resume afterward.
Silverfish Call Pause
Own MOVE and stop navigation during the vanilla friends-call goal.
Silverfish Call Particles
One particle per infested block actually destroyed by native help. Ally release still follows native game rules.
Silverfish Shovel Weakness
Direct melee damage with a main-hand shovel is doubled; projectiles are unaffected.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.b: Hard only: wind-charge-style takeoff burst, 100-tick cooldown; no block triggers when mobGriefing is false.
Hard only: wind-charge-style landing burst with a separate cooldown.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.e: Evoker flee speed style
Independent Buildup legacy style: native avoid navigation uses 0.4 far /0.8 near speed. Does not change movement attributes or casting.
Evoker avoid lifecycle
Native avoid goal stops for invalid threats, casting or active Buildup specials. Other goals and spell/summon budgets remain.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.s: Glowing discovery
Supported rebuilt mobs can discover glowing targets within at most 16 blocks through obstacles. Blindness wins; physical attack line of sight remains required.
Blind discovery range
Initial active discovery is capped at follow range / 3. Does not erase existing targets or hurt retaliation.
Sense Darkness
Darkness pulses visibility between 0.35 and 0.65; use the strongest observer impairment.
Nausea discovery and aim
Initial discovery x0.8; supported mob projectiles add sqrt(clamped amplifier / 255) x122.5 +10 uncertainty. Amplifier 0–255; players, dispensers and unsupported owners unchanged.
Invisible discovery ceiling
Initial discovery ceiling is follow range /4; stricter native armor/component visibility is preserved, without multiplying both reductions.
Crawling discovery ceiling
Dry crawling initial discovery ceiling is follow range /3. Swimming in water is not crawling.
Sneaking discovery ceiling
Initial discovery ceiling is follow range /2. Invisible and crawling posture rules take priority; using/swinging can increase reduced range by 20%.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.m: Native melee cooldown adds 2 ticks per fatigue level and subtracts 2 per haste level, clamped 6–200. Native invulnerability and damage remain.
Hard difficulty only, grounded small supported attackers with physical sight and clear overhead; excludes water, riders and large bodies.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.r: For rebuilt skeleton sniper mode: occasionally seek reachable positions around the target and safely adjust distance. Independently switchable.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.o: Slightly shorten melee timing against ominous targets without adding attribute buffs.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.g: Scale actual ghast fireball launch speed and acceleration by 0.6.
40-tick windup; reserve 100 complete quiet ticks after firing, then charge again. Cooldown survives loading.
Slight client-side charge expansion and brief tint, retaining vanilla mouth animation.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.b: Hold real native small fireballs as indexed semicircle passengers for 40 ticks, then aim and release; interruption cleans them up.
Two, three or four shots per volley on Easy, Normal or Hard; disabling restores the native three.
Request lateral flight during firing only when the destination is clear.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.v: Positive projectile-tag damage receives extra +200% (three times total) before native armor. Other damage, zero and negative inputs unchanged.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.p: Recognize CrossbowItem subclasses and the actual hand; nonstandard weapons need adapters.
Use a 15-block approach and stop radius consistent with the ranged goal.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.s: Skeleton Horse Charge Chance
One birth selection per 1000, default 10 (1%); no mount is generated. Load/conversion never rerolls an existing choice.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.c: One birth selection per 1000, default 10 (1%); only an existing baby zombie chicken rider can use it. Load/conversion never rerolls an existing choice.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.z: Zombie Slime Carrier Chance
Birth weight per 1000, default 10; range 0–1000. Exclusive weights above 1000 are normalized. Existing entities never reroll.
Zombie Horse Leader Chance
Birth weight per 1000, default 10; range 0–1000. Exclusive weights above 1000 are normalized. Existing entities never reroll.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.w: Birth weight per 1000, default 70; range 0–1000. Exclusive weights above 1000 are normalized. Existing entities never reroll.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.p: Birth weight per 1000, default 70; range 0–1000. Exclusive weights above 1000 are normalized. Existing entities never reroll.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.s: Stray Snow Barrage Chance
Birth weight per 1000, default 70; range 0–1000. Exclusive weights above 1000 are normalized. Existing entities never reroll.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.e: Evoker Fireball Chance
Birth weight per 1000, default 70; range 0–1000. Exclusive weights above 1000 are normalized. Existing entities never reroll.
Evoker Totem Chance
Birth weight per 1000, default 10; range 0–1000. Exclusive weights above 1000 are normalized. Existing entities never reroll.
Enderman Combo Chance
Per thousand, default 70, range 0–1000. Sampled once for natural or spawn-egg births; loading never rerolls.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.i: Birth weight per 1000, default 70; range 0–1000. Exclusive weights above 1000 are normalized. Existing entities never reroll.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.extended.s: Special Cooldown
Evoker fireball and enderman combo cooldown in ticks. Default 400; range 200–2400.
buildupmobtweaks.main.hostile.raid.pilla: Release creative, spectator, dead, distant or persistently hidden targets; retain vanilla reacquisition.

buildupmobtweaks.main.equipment.witherBo: 0–1000; default 10 (1%). One new birth attempt in an empty initialization hand, requiring a matching pool, equipment gate and individual gate; lost gear is never replenished.
